decision.scope: Continuation of catherine-6g2 under hold: both recorded revisit triggers executed. Trigger 2 (standalone-crate wrap) landed as a structural split — crates/catherine-engine (model, EpistemicLabel, engine; serde behind an optional feature the lane disables) plus the new crates/catherine-kani harness member that depends only on it, so `cargo kani -p catherine-kani` compiles the execution core and the harnesses and nothing else; catherine-core wraps both modules verbatim (`pub use catherine_engine::{engine, model}`) with the parsed-flavor adapters (compile_typed, rendering, the label re-export) staying kernel-side — every downstream path unchanged, full suite + clippy + fmt green on the new layout. Then the wall was profiled (CBMC verbosity 9 traces, standalone replicas) and the engine made solver-shaped, one measured toxin at a time: slice-sort internals (smallsort::insert_tail, heapsort::sift_down, swap_nonoverlapping_chunks — the dominant VCC source) replaced by a capacity-asserted insertion sort and plain dedup at every engine sort site (emitted order unchanged: family sort keys are distinct within each domain); binary-search membership over symbolically-populated vectors replaced by linear scans (domains of a handful); iterator-collect chains over symbolic cells (instance_for, lane entry tables) rewritten as plain loops with capacity-asserted appends; engine_build's report vectors moved to push_bounded (plain push measured 3.7x wall / 3x memory standalone); witness-soundness harnesses upgraded from sampled-index+assume to a for-all loop over emitted findings (strictly stronger claim, no symbolic division or heap indexing); harness-side drop glue skipped via mem::forget (drop/dealloc modeling dominated symex: 154 s of the 300 s wall on build alone); the all-families sortedness harness declares its own unwind 48 (finding space exceeds the default 16 for sort loops). Measured after all of it: machinery completes — build_panic_freedom symex reaches conversion (152 s, 24 k VCCs after slicing) — but the solve phase still exceeds the 300 s wall, and walkers+soundness formulas remain above it; soundness_dangling does not complete even at 900 s without the forget change. Dispositions updated in docs/kani-lane.md; the lane outcome is unchanged (all 11 harnesses undetermined-with-disposition, lane green).
decision.rationale: Hold maintained, with the obligation refined rather than the budget widened: every change here is measured against a probe or profile, the parsed kernel is byte-identical and fully green (contract suite, golden fixtures, parity nets), nothing is cited as proved, and undetermined stays loud. The refined split obligation replaces 'toolchain limitation': the residual wall is symbolic-execution volume — allocation modeling (alloc/drop pairs for every intermediate vec on the build path) plus a 24 k VCC propositional core — which a bigger cap demonstrably only buys more of (kissat and the default solver both exceed the wall; the 900 s soundness run peaked at 7.7 GB). Revisit triggers, replacing 0002's: (1) cfg(kani)-shaped arena structures for the lane flavor — fixed-capacity tables and indices instead of heap vectors on the proven path — re-run build_panic_freedom first; (2) a solver-phase budget decision taken through the stop gate (Decision 6) if a profile shows symex well inside budget with solve time dominating at 300 s; (3) a Kani release whose alloc modeling stops exploring growth branches on symbolic lengths (vec_push_within_capacity stabilization retires the capacity-asserted append helpers).
decision.fixture_only_comparison: Unchanged from 0002 at the assurance level: fixture-corpus parity, golden fixtures, hegel properties and the full workspace suite stayed green through the engine split and every solver-shaping change (the parsed flavor's public output is pinned byte-identical by the contract suite, and the insertion-sort change is order-identical because every family's sort keys are distinct within its domain). What this arc bought: the lane's compiled unit shrank to the execution core; five measured solver toxins were removed from the engine (sorts, binary searches, collect chains, plain pushes, drop glue at harness tails); the soundness obligations got strictly stronger; and build reached the solver phase (152 s symex, 24 k VCCs) where 0002 stalled in symex. What remains held: every declared harness verdict, with the wall now measured as solve-phase volume rather than toolchain modeling.
